name: context-handoff
description: At a set share of context used, lock the session until it hands off through a handoff skill of your choice, so long sessions stop re-sending huge histories.

threshold.title: Context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Share of the context window used at which the session locks and hands off. It is a share of the model's window: on a 1M-token window, 50 is about 500k tokens.

skill.title: Handoff skill
skill.description: Skill the session runs to hand off, without its slash (e.g. solo-handoff). It should end by calling the plugin's handoff_complete tool. Leave empty to write a handoff file to docs/handoffs/ and continue in a fresh session yourself.
